- Dataflow diagram showing where telemetry and request metadata live and any transient caches

- Confirmation of encryption at rest + key jurisdiction (KMS region)

I've attached our Vendor Questionnaire (acmecorp_scoped-access-questionnaire.pdf) with the fields security wants filled. Can you get this back by EOD Wednesday (our tracker deadline)?

Thanks — quick status and proposed package below.

Summary (for Acme):
- Affirmation: one-page PDF (attached) scoped to StreamBrief pilot, dates 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-01, contact info and signature block included.
- Dataflow diagram: PDF attached (dataflow_diagram_eu.pdf) showing ingestion -> processing (StreamBrief) -> ephemeral KV cache -> short-term aggregation in EU S3 bucket.
- Retention: telemetry logs (30 days), request metadata (7 days), aggregated analytics (90 days, aggregated and non-identifiable). No full request/response bodies are persisted beyond 7 days unless customer opt-in is enabled.
- Encryption: data encrypted at rest using KMS-eu-1 (customer-specific keys are not exported outside EU). In-transit TLS 1.2+.
- Controls: minimal role-based access, time-limited service accounts for StreamBrief, and automatic token revocation post-pilot.

Attachments included in this reply: redwood_scoped-affirmation-acmecorp.pdf; dataflow_diagram_eu.pdf. I also uploaded the evidence folder (internal drive) and linked it: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-scoped-affirmation.

A couple of internal implementation notes:
- The KV cache used during aggregation is ephemeral (TTL < 60s) and not persisted to disk; we maintain an audit log of access (available on request).
- Backups of the EU S3 are geo-redundant within EU zones only; we do not replicate to non-EU regions for this pilot.

Kimberly — can you quickly verify the KMS jurisdiction phrasing below before I send to Acme? Proposed line: "Encryption at rest is provided via KMS-eu-1; Customer data associated with the StreamBrief pilot is stored and keys are managed exclusively in EU jurisdictions and are not exported outside the EU."

If that's all good I will attach the affirmation and send to Liam with a DocuSign option.

- Marissa

Attachments: redwood_scoped-affirmation-acmecorp.pdf, dataflow_diagram_eu.pdf
